name: OceanCarbon
description:
Simulates the uptake of CO2 by the global ocean through air-sea gas exchange
using an Impulse Response Function (IRF) approach.

# What This Component Does

1. Calculates air-sea CO2 flux based on the partial pressure difference
   between atmosphere and ocean surface

2. Tracks how absorbed carbon mixes into the deep ocean using an IRF
   convolution that "remembers" past flux history

3. Updates ocean surface pCO2 accounting for:
   - DIC accumulation (Joos A24 polynomial)
   - Temperature effect on solubility (Joos A25)

4. Integrates over monthly substeps (12 substeps per year). As in MAGICC7, atmospheric
   CO2 evolves within the year from the other carbon sources and the ocean
   uptake, so the uptake responds to the rising concentration.
   Up to `concentration_switch_year` it is instead interpolated linearly to
   `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2`.

Biosphere CO2 emissions are part of the net atmosphere to land flux, as in `CO2Budget`.

# Inputs

- `Emissions|CO2|Permafrost` (GtC/yr), only with the `include_permafrost` parameter
- `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2` (ppm), only with the `concentration_switch_year` parameter

# Differences from MAGICC7

- **Three IRF methods**: 3D-GFDL (default), 2D-BERN, and HILDA are
  implemented. MAGICC7 also supports BOXDIFF.
- **No radiative-only mode**: MAGICC7 can make the ocean "see" only pre-industrial CO2.
  Not implemented.
- **No biological pump**: Only abiotic chemistry is represented.
- **No circulation changes**: the IRF is static and does not respond to warming.

inputs.name: Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2
inputs.description: Atmospheric CO2 concentration at the start of the year

inputs.name: Surface Air Temperature Change
inputs.description: Drives the pCO2 feedback through the warming since `temperature_feedback_start_year`, floored at zero

inputs.name: Emissions|CO2|Fossil
inputs.description: Fossil CO2 emissions over the step, which raise CO2 within the year

inputs.name: Emissions|CO2|CH4 Oxidation
inputs.description: CO2 from oxidised fossil CH4 over the step

inputs.name: Net Atmosphere to Land Flux|CO2
inputs.description: Net atmosphere to land flux over the step, positive for uptake

outputs.name: Net Atmosphere to Ocean Flux|CO2
outputs.description: Mean air-sea flux over the step, positive for ocean uptake

outputs.name: Ocean Carbon Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2
outputs.description: Atmospheric CO2 after the last substep, which `CO2Budget` carries into the next year

states.name: Ocean Surface Partial Pressure|CO2
states.description: Ocean surface CO2 partial pressure at the end of the step

states.name: Cumulative Carbon Uptake|Ocean
states.description: Total carbon absorbed by the ocean by the end of the step

parameters.name: method
parameters.description:
Ocean carbon method (MAGICC7 `OCEANCC_MODEL`).

This field is informational only: it does not select the
corresponding IRF coefficients or physical parameters.
Use the named constructors (`gfdl_3d()`, `bern_2d()`, `hilda()`) to get a
self-consistent parameter set for a given method.
Setting only this field leaves the IRF parameters at their 3D-GFDL defaults.

parameters.name: co2_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial atmospheric CO2 concentration (MAGICC7 `CO2_PREINDCO2CONC`)

unit: ppm

parameters.name: pco2_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial ocean surface pCO2.

unit: ppm

When unset, the initial `Ocean Surface Partial Pressure|CO2` is used.
MAGICC7 takes the first-year atmospheric concentration.

parameters.name: gas_exchange_scale
parameters.description:
Gas exchange rate scaling factor (MAGICC7 `OCEANCC_SCALE_GASXCHANGE`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: gas_exchange_tau
parameters.description:
Characteristic time for air-sea equilibration, which depends on the method

unit: yr

parameters.name: temperature_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Temperature sensitivity of pCO2, the Joos A25 exponent (MAGICC7 `OCEANCC_TEMPFEEDBACK`)

unit: K^-1

parameters.name: irf_scale
parameters.description:
IRF scaling factor (MAGICC7 `OCEANCC_SCALE_IMPULSERESPONSE`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: mixed_layer_depth
parameters.description:
Mixed layer depth, which depends on the method

unit: m

parameters.name: ocean_surface_area
parameters.description:
Ocean surface area, which depends on the method

unit: m^2

parameters.name: sst_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial sea surface temperature for the Joos A24 pCO2-DIC polynomial.

unit: degC

It depends on the method.

parameters.name: steps_per_year
parameters.description: Substeps per year, 12 (monthly) by default as in MAGICC7

parameters.name: maximum_history_months
parameters.description:
Maximum flux history length in substeps.

Limits memory for the IRF convolution.
6000 monthly substeps are 500 years.

parameters.name: irf_switch_time
parameters.description:
Time at which the IRF switches from its early to its late form

unit: yr

parameters.name: irf_early
parameters.description: IRF form for the early regime, before the switch time

parameters.name: irf_late
parameters.description: IRF form for the late regime, after the switch time

parameters.name: delta_ospp_offsets
parameters.description: Joos A24 polynomial offsets

parameters.name: delta_ospp_coefficients
parameters.description: Joos A24 polynomial temperature coefficients

parameters.name: include_temperature_feedback
parameters.description: Apply the temperature feedback on pCO2 (MAGICC7 `CO2_TEMPFEEDBACK_SWITCH`)

parameters.name: temperature_feedback_start_year
parameters.description:
Year from which warming drives the pCO2 temperature feedback (MAGICC7 `CO2_TEMPFEEDBACK_YRSTART`).

unit: yr

The feedback uses the warming since this year, floored at zero.

parameters.name: flux_change_limit
parameters.description:
Largest change in air-sea flux between substeps.

unit: ppm/yr

MAGICC7 applies this limiter for stability.
A non-positive value disables it.

parameters.name: gtc_per_ppm
parameters.description:
Conversion factor from atmospheric carbon mass to CO2 concentration, which must agree with `CO2Budget`

unit: GtC/ppm

parameters.name: include_permafrost
parameters.description:
Add `Emissions|CO2|Permafrost` to the other sources (MAGICC7 `PF_APPLY`).

Must agree with `CO2Budget`.

parameters.name: concentration_switch_year
parameters.description:
Last year of prescribed CO2, interpolated within the year's substeps
(MAGICC7 `CO2_SWITCHFROMCONC2EMIS_YEAR`).

unit: yr

Must agree with `CO2Budget`.
